description: Search Console sitemaps.list/sitemaps.get: every sitemap submitted for the connected property and its processing status (pending, last downloaded, warning/error counts, per-content-type submitted counts), or one named sitemap. Read-only — needs only the `webmasters.readonly` scope this deployment's Search Console connection already requests. Submit/delete need the broader `webmasters` scope and are deliberately not offered. Free (no credits) but spends one call of Google's per-property quota. Omit `feedpath` to list every sitemap; pass one (a sitemap's own URL) to fetch just that one instead — either way the response is `sitemaps`, a one-entry array for `feedpath`. `lastSubmitted`/`lastDownloaded`/`warnings`/`errors` are absent, not zero, when Google has nothing to report for that field.

feedpath.description: A specific sitemap's own URL (e.g. another entry's own `path`). Omitted lists every sitemap Search Console has on record for the property.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_search_console_sitemaps
